limits: a name is not an object: the writer arm reports sites that write the same key on the same spelled name elsewhere in the module, which can be a different object entirely
the receiver is classified by its leftmost name only: self.cfg is read as a container off a parameter, not as the attribute of a resolved class
no interprocedural descent: a called function in the interval is not followed here (E626 followed handovers one hop for the value test only)
no concurrency model: a writer outside the module, or between the two reads through another path, is out of reach
no rebinding-through-a-call analysis: a name assigned from a call result is a local binding, and where that object comes from is not traced
the population is the one E627 published; this study excludes itself, its smoke leg and its probe, and keeps every earlier study's self-exclusion set
answer: Over 34 live dead face-key line(s) the receiver is a parameter of the function in 10, bound inside its body in 21, read out of a container that arrives from outside in 1 and out of a container bound inside in 2, a module-level name in 0, an import alias in 0 and unresolvable in 0.  2 of the 4 same-object duplicate row(s) read an object whose origin lies before the interval E625-E627 scan (the other 2 are bound inside it, 0 unresolved), and 0 of those 2 names is written at that key by another site in the module
